content.text: Only plan.md#step-N and plan.md#verify are anchors, so each Job gets its own step.

grid job lint job-2.json --task task-export && grid job post --task task-export --after J-1 --body '{"title":"Add the export command","role":"builder","intent":{"owner":"intent.md#L3","item":"plan.md#step-2","goal":"plan.md#verify"}}'

grid job lint job-3.json --task task-export && grid job post --task task-export --after J-2 --body '{"title":"Document the export format","role":"builder","intent":{"owner":"intent.md#L3","item":"plan.md#step-3","goal":"plan.md#verify"}}'
